ml_improvement_rule: At least 0.02 validation F1 gain over persistent physics with no increase above baseline +0.1 false alerts/day; otherwise choose simpler baseline.
probability_policy: Raw classifier score only; no claim of calibrated field failure probability
test_policy: Evaluate all candidates once on final sets after selection; never retune; conditional/no lock if gates fail.
label_policy: Train annotations exported during generation to training-only file; evaluation truth used only for auditing and metrics.
sensitivity: Report shifted calibration/parameter results even when acceptance fails
